messages:
vendor_ops: FYI — last night's bulk H100 shipment AWB `125-AGB-998277` is on hold at FRA customs. They flagged an HS-code reclassification. 42/60 units held, ETA ~72h to clear.
maria_g: ouch. those 42 were the reserve for the EU prod pool, right?
kevin_lee: correct. remaining 18 already routed to AMS and cleared.
tarun_ops: can forwarder split the AWB and air-divert the 18 cleared units to our AMS depot so we can stage them? we need throughput tomorrow.
vendor_ops: yes can split, but forwarder requires AWB reissue + EUR 3,200 diversion fee + updated commercial invoice. insurance re-eval may add ~EUR 800.
lia_pm: rough math -> ~EUR 4k extra. finance sign-off needed. also need clarity on RMA flow if some of the held units come in DOA after customs unpack.
maria_g: vendor flagged a possible firmware mismatch on a small subset during preflight — might increase DOA risk. we should request RMA labels and photography evidence protocol now.
vendor_ops: we'll prep RMA label batch and photo checklist. if split accepted we can attach provisional RMA labels to the 18 diverted units' docs; for the 42 held units we can retroactively add labels once cleared.
kevin_lee: ops tradeoff: accept split+pay expedite (~4k) to keep prod running vs wait 72h and risk capacity outage. leaning to split.
lia_pm: tagging @finance: need approval up to EUR 4,000 for forwarder diversion + insurance. this is time-sensitive.
finance_team: saw the tag. we can approve emergency spend up to EUR 4k but need a one-line PO amendment and receipts. vendor to submit debit note and attach AWB reissue.
vendor_ops: ok will reissue AWB once we get PO amendment. forwarding broker contact: +49 69 1234 5678 or broker@euforward.com. who owns PO amendment?
maria_g: @lia_pm please push the PO amendment. also request vendor to include serial ranges so we can pre-register in depot.
lia_pm: on it. I'll send the PO amendment and CC finance. vendor — please include serial ranges and a CSV with model/serial/firmware if available.
vendor_ops: sending CSV in 15m. provisional AWB reissue pending PO amendment. also note: if customs fines applied we can dispute, but that adds time. they recommend paying to avoid extra delay.
freightbot: Forwarder update scheduled: Split request received, tentative pickup AMS depot 09:30 CET tomorrow if PO amendment confirmed.
tarun_ops: once AMS has the 18 units, we want immediate staging + QA smoke test (FW check). if >5% fail, we trigger loaner support from vendor for immediate swap.
maria_g: ok. vendor_ops please confirm loaner SLA for swaps on partial DOA from this batch.
vendor_ops: confirmed — 48h swap SLA from depot receipt for units flagged DOA under our loaner program. will include in appendix of the debit note.
kevin_lee: summary: lia to push PO amendment, finance approved up to EUR 4k, vendor to reissue AWB and provide serial CSV, freightbot schedules AMS handover, vendor pre-bakes RMA labels and loaner SLA. proceed with split.
maria_g: thanks everyone. keep channel updates short — post AWB reissue and CSV when available. :thumbsup:
freightbot: Noted. Tracking will post updates under this thread once AWB is active."
